# Qoblex API

> Qoblex is an inventory, order and production management system for small and mid-sized
> product businesses. Its v1 REST API covers products and stock, sale orders, shipments,
> purchasing, goods receipts, bills, manufacturing, batch and lot traceability, custom
> fields and reporting. This documents the endpoints an integration calls. Authentication is a single
> `qoblex-x-api-key` header. The rate limit is 30 requests per 60 seconds, list pages are
> zero-based, and webhooks are announced but not yet in v1.

Base URL: https://api.qoblex.com, every path under /v1.
OpenAPI 3.0.1: https://api.qoblex.com/swagger/v1/swagger.json

## Start here

- [Agent brief](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qoblex/agent-toolkit/main/AGENTS.md): base URL, auth, the rate limit, and the eight mistakes that cost an afternoon.
- [Authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qoblex/agent-toolkit/main/docs/authentication.md): creating a key, sending it, scopes, and why the 401 mentions Bearer.
- [Conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qoblex/agent-toolkit/main/docs/conventions.md): paging, filtering, sorting, expanding, errors, rate limits, dates, versioning.
- [Finding out what changed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qoblex/agent-toolkit/main/docs/changes.md): the polling pattern to use until webhooks ship.

## Examples

- [Working scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qoblex/agent-toolkit/main/examples/README.md): low stock, expiring batches, change polling, drafting purchase orders.
- [API client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qoblex/agent-toolkit/main/examples/lib/qoblex.mjs): zero-dependency Node, handles pacing, backoff and paging.
- [Claude skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qoblex/agent-toolkit/main/skills/qoblex/SKILL.md): drop-in skill for Claude Code and claude.ai.
